style_blocks.text: A bold serif parent establishes inherited defaults. Its words continue onto a second line so the generous line spacing is visible.
This child explicitly resets bold to false and switches to a sans serif family. It begins without an indent and uses tighter line spacing.

A monospaced paragraph stays in reading order.
Its second line retains an intentional break.

normalization.text: Whitespace reflow is allowed except the explicit monospaced line break. Case remains significant.
normalization.styles: The reset bold=false, zero indent and family/line-spacing differences are explicit values; absent values must not be substituted for false or zero.
